commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+6' What was Caleb Okoli (Leicester) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+2' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Jannik Vestergaard (Leicester) for his blatant foul.
90+1' The Newcastle players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
85' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
82' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to substitute Bilal El Khannouss and he is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester).
81' Substitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) on for Anthony Gordon.
80' 10:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

79' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
76' The Leicester players are exchanging some short passes.
73' Here comes a substitution. Alexander Isak is given a rest as he is replaced by William Osula (Newcastle Utd).

73' The ball falls kindly for Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Thomas Bramall didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Neat passing move from Newcastle in order to create new attacking opportunities.
64' Here's the change. Bruno Guimaraes leaves the pitch and Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
64' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Valentino Livramento will be replaced by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacob Murphy leaves the pitch and Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
60' 4 - 0 Goal! Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
59' Substitution. Jamie Vardy did his best and is replaced by Patson Daka (Leicester).
59' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Caleb Okoli (Leicester) replacing Hamza Choudhury.
59' Stephy Mavididi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester).

57' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Mads Hermansen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
57' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
55' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
50' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Lewis Hall plays it into the box, and Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 3:0.
49' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Thomas Bramall to decide. The relieved Newcastle players can finally celebrate.
49' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Newcastle players aren’t happy.
47' 2 - 0 GOAL 2:0! The resulting free kick is headed powerfully goalwards by Lewis Hall and Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) glances a header from close range into the back of the net.
46' Caleb Okoli (Leicester) picks up a yellow card.
46' Ruud van Nistelrooy makes a switch. Danny Ward (Leicester) is coming on in place of Mads Hermansen at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The resulting corner from Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Some patient build-up play from Leicester as they look to unlock the defence.
43' The percentage of ball possession is – 63:37.
39' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
39' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
38' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

37' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Mads Hermansen inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
35' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
35' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
34' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

30' 1 - 0 It's in! Anthony Gordon spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 1:0.
30' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
30' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
29' A pass by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
27' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
25' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Newcastle.
24' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' The resulting corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
20' Oliver Skipp (Leicester) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
20' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
19' Leicester seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) takes the corner.
11' Leicester control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' The cross into the penalty area from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
8' It's going to be a corner kick.

8' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Mads Hermansen makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.
7' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Dangerous play by Hamza Choudhury (Leicester). Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The match has just started.
Newcastle will kick-off.
Thomas Bramall is introduced as the referee for today's match.
